meta.title: Spiraldynamik in Musterstadt – Körper im Einklang
meta.description: Körper im Einklang in Musterstadt: physiotherapy based on Spiraldynamik, movement analysis and courses for feet and back. Appointments with Test User.

hero.lead: Pain rarely appears by chance. We analyse how you move, explain what we find and train a movement pattern that takes the load off your joints – step by step, practical and lasting.

about.title: Spiraldynamik – the body as a twisted structure
about.lead: Spiraldynamik is a movement and therapy concept grounded in anatomy. Its starting point: the human body is not assembled from straight, symmetrical parts but is twisted in spirals. That twist is what makes it both stable and mobile – and when it is lost, strain builds up in the same places again and again.
body: The foot shows this most clearly: forefoot and heel are turned against each other, like the two ends of a cloth being wrung out. Only this twist tensions the arch of the foot. If the tension fades, the arch drops – and the load travels on through knee and pelvis into the back.

The same principle runs through the whole chain of movement. This is why Spiraldynamik does not treat only the painful spot but asks which link of the chain has given up its task. Instead of one exercise against one symptom, the result is a changed movement pattern that holds up in daily life.

features.title: Cause, not symptom
features.text: The place that hurts and the place that causes it rarely coincide. We examine the whole chain of movement – foot, knee, pelvis, spine – and work where the strain arises.

features.title: Anatomy as the yardstick
features.text: The basis is the body’s own design, not a catalogue of exercises. What is right for a joint follows from its shape: a hip is built to rotate, a knee barely is.

features.title: Explained so it makes sense
features.text: You see on models and in your own movement what is happening in your body. Once the connection is clear, you correct yourself even when nobody is watching.

features.title: Exercise, not a series of sessions
features.text: Manual techniques create the range of movement that you then use yourself. The aim is not the next appointment, but that you can carry on without us.

examples.title: Foot
examples.text: The twist between forefoot and heel, rolling off over the big toe – relevant for fallen and splayed arches, hallux valgus and heel pain.

examples.title: Leg axis
examples.text: Hip, knee and foot in one line. The knee has little rotation of its own; that belongs in the hip and the foot.

examples.title: Pelvis & spine
examples.text: The double-S shape only carries with an upright pelvis. Uprightness comes from tension, not from effort.

examples.title: Shoulder & neck
examples.text: The shoulder blade needs support on the ribcage. Without it, the neck takes on work it was not built for.

about.origin: Spiraldynamik® was developed from the 1980s onwards by the physician Christian Larsen and the French movement educator Yolande Deswarte, and is taught by the Spiraldynamik® Academy in Zurich. Using it in therapy requires a separate, multi-stage qualification.

offer.title: Treatment in one-to-one sessions
offer.lead: For specific complaints: we look closely at how you move and work on the cause.

items.title: Movement analysis & first assessment
items.text: Detailed history, gait analysis and functional testing. Together we define your goal and the way there.

items.title: Physiotherapy based on Spiraldynamik
items.text: Manual techniques combined with active movement learning for back, knee and shoulder complaints.

items.title: Foot & gait analysis
items.text: Hallux valgus, flat and splay feet, heel spur: we rebuild the arch of your foot functionally.

approach.title: How we work together
approach.lead: A clear path from the first conversation to your own independent practice.

steps.title: Getting to know
steps.text: In the first conversation we clarify your complaints, your goals and your daily routine.

steps.title: Analysing
steps.text: Gait, posture and mobility are examined and explained in plain language.

steps.title: Practising
steps.text: You receive a personal exercise plan and learn to perform the movements precisely.

steps.title: Consolidating
steps.text: In follow-up sessions or in a course we anchor the new pattern in your everyday life.

notes.title: Booking an appointment
notes.text: Appointments are arranged by phone or by email. We set aside 60 minutes for the first session. If you have a medical prescription, please bring it to your first appointment.

notes.title: Cancelling an appointment
notes.text: Please cancel an appointment at least 24 hours in advance. That way someone on the waiting list can take the slot. A short message on the answering machine is enough.

courses.title: Courses in small groups
courses.lead: Over six to eight evenings you learn what matters in the way you move – with exercises you can carry on by yourself afterwards. Eight people per course at most, so there is time for everyone.
benefits: Eight people per group at most
Also available as an in-house course for companies

items.title: Healthy feet
items.text: Arches, rolling motion and choosing footwear. Six evenings, after which you perceive your feet differently and can strengthen them.

items.title: Back in balance
items.text: Upright without effort: spine, pelvis and breathing working together.

items.title: Active at the office
items.text: Compact course for working days – sitting, standing, screen work.
